mentions.name: Cangjie Workbook
mentions.description: This web app is a learning tool for Cangjie, a Chinese input method based on decomposing characters into sub-parts. It helps learners remember characters while typing, offers a free subset usable without login, and provides the complete product for a small monthly fee.
mentions.problem: Cangjie has a high learning curve, making it hard to pick up, though it is fun to type with and helps with remembering Chinese characters.
mentions.source_excerpt: I am working on Cangjie Workbook. I am trying to create the best in class tool for learning Cangjie. It's a Chinese input method based on decomposing characters into sub parts (not necessarily related to how they are written).
mentions.author: mchaver
